firstOccurrence.englishText: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which Yahweh was angry against you to destroy you. But Yahweh listened to me that time also.

timeline.evidenceText: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which Yahweh was angry against you to destroy you. But Yahweh listened to me that time also.
He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.
For the thing which I fear comes on me,
I am afraid of all my sorrows,
Take away my disgrace that I dread,

definitions.full: H3025. yagor [ יָגֹר ] verb be afraid, fear (Phoenician in proper name אשמן יגר = he feareth Eshmun ; Arabic metuens cavit , Frey Lag BN 26.30 ; compare III. גּוּר ) — Qal Perfect 2masculine singular יָגֹרְתָּ Deut 28:60 ; יָגֹּרְתִּי 9:19 3 t.; — be afraid , followed by מִמְּנֵי before, of ; of wrath of ׳י 9:19 ; of diseases of Egypt 28:60 ; fear , followed by accusative Job 3:25 ; 9:28 ; Psa 119:39 .
